name: persona-fan-out
description: Same subject, multiple personas, parallel. `map` iterates over a persona list; each iteration drives the same critique agent under a different lens; the synthesizer rolls per-persona feedback into one set of blockers vs nice-to-haves. Use for QA, product copy review, accessibility review — anywhere 'audience' is the variable.
